# B-SOFT

> B-SOFT is an all-in-one business CRM platform for Indian small and medium
> businesses. It combines six core services in a single login: an AI website
> builder, lead and pipeline CRM, call tracking, a social media hub, team roles
> and permissions, and finance with GST invoicing.

Company: B-SOFT (Google Business Profile: BSOFT)
Website: https://bsoft.ltd
Phone: +91 99649 96599
Email: support@bsoft.ltd (support), connect@bsoft.ltd (sales)
Location: #454, 1st Cross, Mahadeshwara Nagar, Channapatna, Ramanagara District, Karnataka 562160, India
Market: Indian SMBs — agencies, consultants, clinics, real estate, education, salons, insurance and local service businesses. Pricing is in INR.

## What B-SOFT does

- Website & Web Builder: industry templates, website settings, drag-and-drop
  form builder, SEO tools, publishing with custom domain, SSL and free hosting.
  Website lead forms feed directly into the CRM.
- Leads & CRM: pipelines and stages, form builder, table and kanban lead views,
  tasks and follow-ups, automation over email, WhatsApp and SMS.
- Call Tracker: call history and recordings sync from team devices, hourly and
  day-wise reports, per-employee call performance, calls linked to leads.
- Social Hub: connect Facebook and Instagram, publish posts and reels, run Meta
  ad campaigns, WhatsApp business inbox, engagement analytics.
- Team & Permissions: roles and access profiles, employee management,
  package-based menu access.
- Finance & Billing: packages and pricing, coupons, payment transactions
  (UPI, cards, net banking via Indian payment gateway), GST invoices as PDFs,
  incentive wallet and payouts.

## Plans

- Website Pro — AI-built professional website with custom domain, lead forms
  and free hosting.
- CRM Business Suite — the complete platform: website, CRM, calls, social,
  team and finance. Most popular plan.
- Custom Development Studio — bespoke modules and integrations built by a
  dedicated engineering team.

Current INR prices, and the Monthly | Yearly toggle: https://bsoft.ltd/pricing

## Partner program

Partners resell B-SOFT under their own pricing, manage all customers from one
panel, and earn commission per sale. No technical team needed.
Details: https://bsoft.ltd/partner
